verdict.rationale: Postman documents a Fabric Gateway where you register an MCP server and make it available to your team, which is a first-party gateway for MCP traffic. Nothing in the evidence shows LLM traffic proxying or governance controls such as token limits, prompt guards, or provider routing. The API governance rules in the CLI evidence cover spec linting, not traffic governance, so they do not count here. Missing for 10: LLM traffic proxying, token/rate limits, prompt guards, provider routing, depth of MCP gateway governance docs, independent corroboration.
